asm_ida_com:
push    rbp
mov     rbp, rsp
sub     rsp, 50h
mov     [rbp+cipher_text], rdi
mov     [rbp+plain_text], rsi
mov     [rbp+text_size], rdx
mov     [rbp+key], rcx
mov     [rbp+nonce], r8
mov     [rbp+ctr], r9
lea     rdi, [rbp+sub_key]; out
mov     rsi, [rbp+key]; key
mov     rdx, [rbp+nonce]; in
call    crypto_chacha20_h
mov     rdi, [rbp+cipher_text]; cipher_text
mov     rsi, [rbp+plain_text]; plain_text
mov     rdx, [rbp+text_size]; text_size
lea     rcx, [rbp+sub_key]; key
mov     r8, [rbp+nonce]
add     r8, 10h; nonce
mov     r9, [rbp+ctr]; ctr
call    crypto_chacha20_djb
mov     [rbp+ctr], rax
lea     rdi, [rbp+sub_key]; secret
mov     esi, 20h ; ' '; size
call    crypto_wipe
mov     rax, [rbp+ctr]
add     rsp, 50h
pop     rbp
retn
